turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: For the first use of your Yonder® Water Bottle: - Fill it with cold water or another cold drink. - Secure the Yonder® Cap. The cap is 100% leakproof. - Do not use it with hot or carbonated beverages, as storage for food or perishables, or in the freezer. - When you’re ready to clean it, the bottle and cap are dishwasher-safe. We recommend placing lids on the top rack and gaskets in the utensils basket. You can also hand-wash it. Because it is not insulated, condensation may form on the outside.
